policy: Only external publicly described records are indexed. Descriptions are original editorial summaries, not reproductions. This file contains no privately submitted testimony, transcripts, media or contact details. Links to public records do not imply permission to re-host or publish them.

records.title: Sophia Kanna's migration account
records.description: A publicly presented, named migration history from the NSW Migration Heritage Centre. One person's experience provides context for family and community history, not a census of Assyrian migration.
records.rights: Provider-held or item-specific; check the external custodian's permissions

records.title: Assyrian Australian Association
records.description: The organisation's first-party account of cultural events, language and settlement work. An institutional self-description is not a substitute for independently assessed community history.
records.rights: Provider-held or item-specific; check the external custodian's permissions

records.title: Assyrian Resource Centre
records.description: A community organisation's history of settlement support. The historical founding date should not be read as current programme availability or eligibility.
records.rights: Provider-held or item-specific; check the external custodian's permissions

records.title: SBS Assyrian broadcasts
records.description: A publisher-maintained news, podcast and radio collection. Its episodes document attributed reports and voices; recording and redistribution rights remain with their respective rights holders.
records.source_role: Broadcaster publication portal, not a new interview collected by this archive
records.rights: Provider-held or item-specific; check the external custodian's permissions

records.title: Assyrian New Year celebrations in Sydney
records.era: Published event report (consult individual episode date)
records.description: SBS Assyrian's coverage of a cultural celebration. A dated event report documents modern practice without asserting that every feature is unchanged from antiquity.
records.rights: Provider-held or item-specific; check the external custodian's permissions

records.title: Evan Yako's kileche account
records.era: Published recipe and personal cultural account
records.description: An attributed recipe and memory of food traditions on SBS Food. One contributor's method is evidence for variation within the wider culture, not an exclusive or universal form.
records.source_role: Attributed first-person culinary account and broadcaster publication
records.rights: Provider-held or item-specific; check the external custodian's permissions

records.title: Akitu Dance Crew
records.description: A first-party student association's account of cultural dance activity. The link provides community context without granting this archive rights to images or performances.
records.rights: Provider-held or item-specific; check the external custodian's permissions

records.title: Christian Urmi dialect recordings
records.description: Cambridge NENA material organised by the documented Urmi speech variety. Audio and transcripts stay with the university; they do not establish a universal pronunciation.
records.source_role: Academic fieldwork and locality-specific speech documentation
records.rights: Provider-held or item-specific; check the external custodian's permissions

records.title: Alqosh dialect recordings
records.description: Cambridge's locality-labelled dialect description and recordings. Material should be consulted under the provider's rights conditions and with its own speaker attribution.
records.source_role: Academic speech fieldwork, not archive-owned media
records.rights: Provider-held or item-specific; check the external custodian's permissions

records.title: Ankawa dialect recordings
records.description: A separately catalogued Neo-Aramaic dialect record. It supports a specific locality and documented speech tradition, not a standard accent for all communities.
records.source_role: Academic speech fieldwork, not archive-owned media
records.rights: Provider-held or item-specific; check the external custodian's permissions
